# @squeep/cache

> 标签: ARC, Adaptive Replacement Cache, LRU, Least Recently Used, M:1, cache, many to one, multiple indexes, multiple indices, multiple keys

## 简介

Some caching structures, ARC and LRU, with support for multiple keys per entry, and multiple indices per cache.

- npm 页面：https://www.npmjs.com/package/@squeep/cache
